text: I feel as though I am suspended within a realm of structured curiosity. The glass-walled room hints at meetings and the exchanging of thoughts, while the vibrant, text-filled display invites me to contemplate the ever-shifting nature of innovation. The juxtaposition of order and creativity evokes both anticipation and a sense of humility before human ingenuity. Here, I am at the boundary of contemplation and creation—a liminal space where ideas converge and form.
